item.text: I’m implementing streaming as revision-pinned pagination: one count read establishes the snapshot, subsequent finite key-ordered reads advance strictly past the last key, and only the final message carries header/More/Count. CountOnly takes the single-response path; send and cancellation errors return immediately.
